_what: THE ARMS TAGGED BY WHAT THEY GUARD, (R327)(2): CLAIM where an arm guards a statement, a pin, a grade, a registration, a computed figure, or a sentence a reader of the corpus meets; CLOSE where it guards the close's own record of itself and nothing a reader of the corpus meets. Read by the suite's tallies and the closing (the claim arms' figure printed beside the whole suite's). Written at b717's step zero by the Write tool over the 139 arms of b716's suite as data/b716_arms_prerun.txt prints them (:65-:152, :184-:191, :219, :309, :335-:375), the act's arms carried under their b717 names (G-R326-ENTERED -> G-R327-ENTERED); an arm the act adds later is entered here by the Edit tool before the suite runs. At Component 6 (the Edit tool): b716's five toolset arms (G-TOOL-REPAIRS, G-REPAIR-CONTROLS, G-TOOLSET-SCAN, G-TOOLSET-REPLAY, G-COVERAGE-TABLE, all CLOSE) removed with their arms; six added (G-LIST-CERTIFIED, G-PREDICTIONS-BEFORE-ONSETS, G-ONSETS-HELD, G-COEFFS-LAW, G-NAMES-PINNED CLAIM -- the -39 figures and the names' pins a reader meets; G-ARM-TAGS CLOSE). An arm absent from this map is untagged and printed so by the tally, never counted as either.

reasons.CLAIM: the kernels' statements and axioms (G-NO-SORRY-MAIN, G-AXIOM-CLAIM, G-MODULE-HEADER and their planted controls), their pins and builds (G-KERNELS-UNTOUCHED, G-MERGES-ON-GATE, G-RUNNER-READ, G-RUNNER-GATE, G-WORKFLOW-FILES, G-SISTER-PINS), the papers and their rows a reader meets (G-PP-SCOPE, G-CURRENTS-UNEDITED, G-KEYSTONE-EDITS, G-CORRESPONDENCE-CURRENCY, G-README-CURRENCY, G-PARTNER-COPIES, G-ROWGEN-STEPZERO, G-RULE-RECUT-QUOTE, G-OUTSIDE-NAMED-NOWHERE, G-NODISCLOSURE-PUBLIC, G-PUBLISH-UNCALLED), the ledger's sentences (G-FINDINGS-APPEND-ONLY, G-FINDINGS-ENTRY, G-WEIGHT-LINE, G-CORRIGENDUM-ENTERED, G-ENTRY-TITLE-FORM, G-ENTRY-SCORES-EQUAL), the registrations, the prices and the instruments that compute the figures (G-REGISTRATIONS-FIRST, G-PRICES-BANKED, G-INSTRUMENTS-UNEDITED), the -39 test's figures and the names' pins (G-LIST-CERTIFIED, G-PREDICTIONS-BEFORE-ONSETS, G-ONSETS-HELD, G-COEFFS-LAW, G-NAMES-PINNED)
reasons.CLOSE: every other arm: the close's order, its banks, seal, root, trail, mirror, scores, reads, writes, deletes, branches, hooks and the act's own lettering -- the close's record of itself
